title: Zone list slot
statement: Given a natural number $\ell$, a family of $\ell$ lists of possibly absent Boolean values, and a natural number $s$, first set $i=\lfloor\log_2(\lfloor s/2\rfloor+1)\rfloor$. If $i<\ell$, return the list entry at index $s-2(2^i-1)$ when that index is within the list; otherwise return no value.
hypotheses_covered: A family of lists indexed by $i<\ell$
